title: Life Is Beautiful
synopsis: A waiter in Arezzo, a librarian he calls Principessa, and a game in a camp that he invents to keep a small boy alive.

nodes.text: Joshua wins his prize, a real tank, an American boy lifting him up. Dora finds him in a market three days later and they go home.
A waiter, a bookseller, a father turning a hard year into a game his son will tell his own children about, hand on a kitchen table.
Joshua paints the pink horse the same color his father did, and rides it through Arezzo at a parade, and people cry without knowing why.
